name: mirage
text: Findings so far on the three problems, from your 22:03 UTC diagnostics. (1) Slow bets: Novig took the order in 81 ms, then 5.1 s went on waiting for it to end, and the live feed was off ('Novig live feed NOT connected'). Novig also returned 'slow down' (429) on the fills lookup around your taps. I added a per-read timing trail to the next diagnostics, which will show whether Novig holds orders open or our reads are slow. (2) 'Nobody selling': both misses in that file were NCAAF games at kickoff (starts in 0 min), where Novig has no asks left. Next I'll stop listing, and warn on hand taps for, games within a few minutes of kickoff. (3) Bets vanishing from the list: the same kickoff games, plus NFL spreads 15 to 46 hours out whose opposing bids disappeared on the next read, so the price had no seller left. That one is Novig's thin book, not a bug. I haven't released anything yet. The trail ships with the next batch, and I'll next look into why the live feed isn't connected and what is hitting the fills lookup during taps.
